title: Chocolate-Covered Strawberry Pie
description: This chocolate-covered strawberry pie recipe layers a blend of cream cheese and sour cream with fresh strawberries and jam in a chocolate-coated crust
ingredients: 2 (8 ounce) packages cream cheese, room temperature

steps.text: Place 2 ounces chocolate and 2 tablespoons butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on 30% power for 2 ½ minutes, stirring occasionally, until melted. Spread chocolate mixture over bottom and up sides of pie crust; place crust in the freezer.
Beat cream cheese in a large bowl using an electric mixer until smooth; beat in sour cream, sugar, and vanilla bean paste. Pour cream cheese filling into chilled crust.
Combine strawberries and jam in a bowl; spread over cream cheese filling.

Combine remaining 1 ounce chocolate and remaining 1 tablespoon butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on 30% power, about 1 minute, until melted. Drizzle chocolate mixture over pie with a spoon. Refrigerate before serving, about 30 minutes.
